title: Ibtedaae aza hai
body:
Ibtedaae aza hai waawaila
Maahe gham ro numa hai waawaila
Is mahine me jaabaja yaaro
Maatame syeda hai waawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
Hil rahi hai mazaar Zahra ki
Haae maahe aza hai waawaila
Is mahine me laal Zahra ka
Zibha Pyasa hua hai waawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
Is mahine me Fatima ka ghar
qaak me mil gaya hai waawaila
Is mahine me ibne Shabbar ka
Tukde sehra hua hai waawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
Is Mahine me naujawa’n Akber
Haaye maara gaya hai waawaila
Is Mahine me teer se ran me
Halqe Asghar chida hai waawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
Is mahine me daste aada me
Chaadare Syeda hai waawaila
Is mahine me aye ameere hazee’n
Kya na mehshar hua hai waawaila
